record.question: Who is the present Chairman of Indian Space Research Organization?
record.explanation: Answer B: K. Radhakrishnan. ISRO’s historical chairman profile identifies K. Radhakrishnan’s chairmanship beginning in October 2009, covering 24 March 2010. Historical/source note: Historical officeholder, not the present ISRO chair. Reference: https://www.isro.gov.in/Radhakrishnan.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
